theme_and_archetype.description: A premium, function-forward, asymmetrical design that breaks away from standard social media templates. Focuses on full-width imagery, clean typography, visible structural elements (like thin borders), and minimal decoration to feel completely different from Instagram.

typography.description: High contrast between structured headers and clean functional body text. Use React Native system fonts.

components.MoView: Base container wrapping React Native View. Supports safe area, padding, and semantic background colors.
components.MoText: Text wrapper implementing typography system. Props: variant (h1, h2, body), color (primary, secondary).
components.MoButton: Primary buttons are solid #3366A0 with sharp corners (radius 0 or 4). Secondary are outlined.
components.MoImage: Image component. Feed posts must be full-width (100% width, 0 horizontal margin).
components.MoAvatar: Square or squicle (radius 4-8) avatars, not perfectly circular. No gradient rings for stories.
components.MoCard: Flat surfaces with 1px border (#E5E5E5), no drop shadows, sharp edges.

layout_patterns.Home_Feed: Full width imagery edge-to-edge. Captions underneath with thick left border or indentation. Asymmetrical engagement buttons (e.g., stacked on the right or text-based at bottom).
layout_patterns.Stories: Horizontal scroll. Use square avatars with thin #3366A0 borders instead of circular gradient rings.
layout_patterns.Reels: Vertical paging scroll. Full screen. Engagement UI pushed to bottom left instead of floating right.
layout_patterns.Profile: Asymmetrical header. Stats using large typography. Feed grid uses masonry layout or alternating large/small rectangles instead of 3x3 squares.
layout_patterns.Navigation: Floating pill-shaped bottom tab bar with glassmorphic effect or solid #FFFFFF with thin border, detached from bottom edge.
layout_patterns.Messages: Minimalist chat bubbles. Sharp corners on one side, rounded on others.

testing_and_accessibility.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) MUST have a testID attribute. Use kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React Native Expo application using standard StyleSheet. The user requested .js files, not .tsx.
Implement the 25 requested screens, ensuring navigation flows between them. Use @react-navigation/native.
Create reusable components prefixed with 'Mo' (MoView, MoText, MoButton, MoImage, MoAvatar) in a components directory and use them exclusively to build UI.
Strictly follow the color palette with #3366A0 as the primary brand color.
Do not use HTML tags like <div> or <span>. Use React Native components.
Avoid typical Instagram clones. Use square/squicle avatars, full-width feed images, floating bottom tab bar, and masonry profile grids.
Add 'testID' to all TouchableOpacity and TextInput components for E2E testing.
